title: 卡特琳娜·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 长红发衬托绿色双眼，棱角分明的面庞带着自信神情。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Katarina is an adult Noxian woman with very long vivid red hair, green eyes, a small facial scar, and a confident angular expression. Preserve her black-red leather and silver armor accents with a fully closed long-sleeved jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Her paired curved daggers remain securely sheathed at the sides, never drawn, raised, or crossing the body.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: scarlet hair, lilac pencil shadow black, silver gray, copper light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
